scope: New public experimental data ingestion and fixed-source-parameter branch predictions; not full directional engine validation.
exploration: GAUGE trial 1 inspected for schema; MIT MATLAB arrays previewed, including a few outcomes. This is not a claim of pristine blind validation. No evaluation outcomes used to change material parameters.

gauge_bounce.trial_ids: all 22 released IDs; trial 1 exploratory pilot, other IDs evaluation
gauge_bounce.parameter: Read restitution 0.576733 unchanged from bouncing ball metadata. No data-specific refit.
gauge_bounce.events: first two valleys with z prominence >= 0.02 m and separation >= 3 frames; record every admission/decline
gauge_bounce.measurement: Fixed-gravity ballistic regressions before/after each valley; exclude one frame adjacent to contact; require >=3 samples each side. Intersect the fitted arcs to estimate the unresolved contact time. Require approaching/separating velocities and intersection within one frame of the valley; otherwise decline.
gauge_bounce.prediction: Outgoing normal speed = source restitution times measured incoming speed. No measured outgoing speed used as an input.
gauge_bounce.limits: Released JSON is 30 Hz despite 180 Hz source capture. Ground/board motion, contact duration, spin coupling and exact same-pair calibration provenance limit interpretation. This is fixed published-metadata consistency, not certified independent material validation.

gauge_slider.trial_ids: all released wood/plastic/metal task-2 trials; ID1 per material is exploratory pilot
gauge_slider.parameters: Read each material's friction unchanged from slope slider metadata; nominal slope 30 degrees; g=9.81. Released field does not separate mu_s and mu_d.
gauge_slider.prediction: Constant downhill acceleration g*(sin(theta)-mu*cos(theta)); no material fitting.
gauge_slider.conditioning: Detect motion at 0.002 m downhill displacement from the initial sample; use the first four moving samples to infer incoming position/velocity with fixed acceleration. Forecast all subsequent samples until initial downhill displacement exceeds 0.30 m, with at least 3 forecast samples required.
metrics: observed acceleration as a diagnostic only
gauge_slider.limits: Prefix state conditioning is not a material fit. Plane release/angle/rotation variation and calibration-source overlap remain possible. This checks an isolated sustained sliding branch, not impact/spin closure.

mit_ellipse.import: All 1718 supplied pre/post planar states and normal/tangent Jacobians; single body index, explicit source units. No further outcome-based filtering.
mit_ellipse.diagnostic: Infer momentum transfer and the extra angular impulse relative to the supplied contact Jacobian. This is reconstruction from observed motion, not a predicted or independently measured contact couple.
mit_ellipse.properties: Source mass 0.0364 kg; ellipse semiaxes 0.035/0.025 m; radius of gyration 0.0192 m; use I=m*k_g^2 rather than assuming a homogeneous ellipse.
mit_ellipse.limits: No independently measured same-pair static/dynamic friction/restitution identified. Do not transfer glass-sphere or rubber coefficients. Public author model parameters fitted from this dataset are not independent material inputs.

other_sources: Catalog limestone block rocking and silicone-shell experiments with data accessibility, state completeness, coefficient provenance and current prediction-readiness. Do not report all cataloged records as already run predictions.
model_policy: Preserve the user's full t/s definitions, independent delta L and reference-length notation. Isolated scalar branch comparisons do not certify the complete model. All mismatches and declines remain in evidence; no target-driven coefficient corrections.
